scope: Bounded structural validation, not full-archive analysis or completion
summary: Validated 34 conversations, 306 mapping nodes, and 272 message objects from one smallest source bin in each batch 00–03. Explicit children fields are absent in this sample; inverse-parent adjacency reveals 3 branch points. Source content parts include mixed JSON values; metadata paths are conditional. Unobserved keys remain unverified outside the sample. topic/project/outputs are absent as direct conversation keys and require evidence-grounded derivation.
selection: One smallest file by byte size per batch 00–03 (34 conversations total). Convenience/size-stratified sample, biased toward short conversations; not statistically representative of archive-wide presence rates.
